news.headline: LSU freshman OL Lance Heard will transfer to Tennessee
news.description: LSU true freshman offensive lineman Lance Heard announced that he is transferring to Tennessee.

news.headline: Kiffin understands frustration as LSU's playoff hopes dashed
news.description: LSU coach Lane Kiffin said it was fair to question the team's 6-4 record this season after losing to Texas on Saturday, a defeat that likely knocked LSU out of playoff contention.

news.headline: Arch Manning leads game-winning drive as Texas stuns LSU
news.description: Arch Manning found Raleek Brown for a 4-yard touchdown pass along the left sideline with 3 seconds left, and Texas escaped Tiger Stadium with a victory over LSU on Saturday night.

news.headline: Kentucky's CFP hopes take hit in upset loss to Gators, Philo
news.description: Florida quarterback Aaron Philo had 221 all-purpose yards and a touchdown to rally the Gators past No. 11 Kentucky 21-14 Saturday.

news.headline: No. 24 Boise State outlasts Oregon State, to host Pac-12 title game
news.description: Rasean Jones caught 11 passes for 230 yards and 3 TDs to help No. 24 Boise State outlast Oregon State 46-41 and wrap up the host spot in the Pac-12 title game.

news.headline: No. 16 Oregon keeps CFP hopes alive with win over Michigan
news.description: Dylan Raiola threw for 341 yards and four touchdowns, and No. 16 Oregon kept its slim chances for a spot in the College Football Playoff alive with a victory over struggling Michigan on Saturday.

wiki.title: Lance Heard
wiki.intro: Zalance "Lance" Heard (born October 13, 2004) is an American college football offensive tackle for the Kentucky Wildcats. He previously played for the LSU Tigers and the Tennessee Volunteers.

sections.title: Early life
sections.text:
Heard was born on October 13, 2004, in Monroe, Louisiana. Heard attended Bastrop High School for two years before transferring to Neville High School. As a junior, he switched to the offensive side of the ball to play right tackle and earned all-district and all-state honors. After his senior season, Heard was invited to play in the U.S. Army Bowl where he caught a touchdown.

RECRUITING
Coming out of high school, Heard was rated as a five-star recruit by On3.com and a four-star recruit by 247Sports and Rivals.com. He committed to play college football for the LSU Tigers over offers from schools such as Nebraska, Florida, Florida State, and Houston.

sections.title: College career
sections.text:
LSU
As a freshman in 2023, Heard played all 12 games, making one start for the Tigers and earning SEC all-freshman honors. After the season, he entered his name into the NCAA transfer portal.

TENNESSEE
Heard transferred to play for the Tennessee Volunteers. He appeared in 11 games in the 2024 season. Heard entered the transfer portal after the 2025 season.
